rationale: CR-001, CR-002, and CR-003 are resolved in the fix-up: poll also enables on in_progress thoughts, refresh keeps a non-empty local response when GET is empty, and restore-failed copy skips terminal execution statuses. No new high-risk issue in the fix-up. Tests cover all three.

business_review.item: After reloading during or after workflow execution, the UI restores and displays the correct workflow execution progress/status.
business_review.notes: transformHistoryGroup preserves in_progress/inProgress when executionStatus is In Progress; ChatPage polls GET and patches in place.

business_review.item: The answer / progress UI is not empty when execution state, progress, partial output, final result, or error information exists (or can be loaded from available APIs).
business_review.notes: Thought cards and Thinking… restored on hydrate; poll copies response/thoughts.

business_review.item: If execution state cannot be restored, show a clear user-facing message instead of a blank answer node.
business_review.notes: Restore-failed copy is implemented but also fires for any empty finished workflow turn (no executionStatus/thoughts/response gate).

business_review.item: For the repro (send message → reload mid-run), the user can see the in-progress step and then subsequent results/steps as the run continues.
business_review.notes: getChat snapshot plus 4s conversation poll while status is In Progress.

business_review.item: Non-workflow cut streams still hydrate as interrupted.
business_review.notes: Existing remap and test retained when preserveProgress is false.

business_review.item: No regression for normal workflow execution without page reload.
business_review.notes: Post-stream refreshWorkflowExecutionIds now overwrites response/inProgress; a lagging In Progress GET can wipe the streamed answer and reopen Thinking.

business_review.item: Cover with unit tests (TDD per SDLC); note manual verification for full reload UX.
business_review.notes: Unit tests for transform, in-place patch, poll lifecycle, empty-state; reload UX noted as manual.

business_review.item: Poll while executionStatus === In Progress; optional old-BE fallback isWorkflow + executionId + thought.in_progress.
business_review.notes: Hydrate implements the fallback; useWorkflowExecutionPoll only keys off executionStatus === RUNNING, so old-BE hydrate never starts polling.

business_review.item: No SSE rejoin; poll via chatsStore only; 4000ms usePolling; snake_case thoughts.
business_review.notes: Hook calls refreshWorkflowExecutionIds only; interval 4000; thought fields unchanged.

standards_review.notes: All four commits match EPMCDME-14075: Capital sentence (no trailing period).
Reuses existing authenticated GET v1/conversations/{id}; no new secrets, injection, or auth bypass. Restore-failed string is a constant, not user-controlled.

finding_status.notes: hasInProgressExecution now also matches thoughts.some(in_progress); test covers missing executionStatus.
keepLocalResponse retains non-empty local response and forces inProgress false when GET message is empty.
showRestoreFailed skips RUNNING and WORKFLOW_FINAL_STATUSES; succeeded empty turn test added.
